after.speaker: Friend
after.known_text: Of course, no problem. You seem to speak it very well. I can understand you easily.

after.speaker: Learner
after.known_text: Thank you, that's good to know. I need to learn more words, and I need to practise listening. I don't understand people very well when they don't speak slowly.

after.speaker: Friend
after.known_text: Am I speaking slowly enough for you now?
after.target_text: Puhunko mä nyt tarpeeksi hitaasti sulle?

after.speaker: Learner
after.known_text: Yes, thank you. It's easier talking to just one person. It's a bit difficult thinking of something to say, though. I'm not sure what to say, but I feel as if I can speak enough to start having conversations.

after.speaker: Friend
after.known_text: I think you're doing very well. I'm impressed. I think you're ready to start speaking Finnish to anyone who speaks Finnish.

after.speaker: Learner
after.known_text: It's just a little frustrating when I can't think quickly enough to express myself properly. But I know that I need to keep practising if I want to speak more confidently.

after.speaker: Friend
after.known_text: You should be confident already. I think you're doing much better than you realise. I feel comfortable speaking with you, and I'm not talking very slowly.

after.speaker: Learner
after.known_text: This is exactly the kind of practice I need. I think I can feel it changing my brain while we're talking! I really appreciate your help. But it's surprising how tired I get when I'm talking in a language I don't speak very well.

after.speaker: Friend
after.known_text: I think that's normal. Learning a new language is difficult. But it's so much fun when you start to have conversations, isn't it?

after.speaker: Learner
after.known_text: It really is. I'm really happy that I can have this much of a conversation. And I hope we'll be able to have more conversations in the future as I keep on getting better.
